description: Get latest observed tidal levels for an EA station to inspect coastal water levels. SI metres; datum qualifier and original unit retained. Not tide predictions. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

latest_n.description: Number of latest readings per measure (default 1, maximum 100).

station_id.description: Station identifier returned by the corresponding provider's station discovery tool.

name: tide_readings
